exercises.why: **добрался** — добра́ться (perfective): to get (to), to reach. Wiktionary: до- + брать + -ся.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **доходит** — доходи́ть (imperfective): to come to, to arrive at, to reach (usually by foot); (by extension) to finally or eventually get to, to achieve some state or condition; (impersonal, colloquial) to become understood (by someone) (e.g. about a joke or fraud); to come down to. Wiktionary: до- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to let down, to lower, to sink (to allow to descend)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: оста́вить — to leave, to leave alone; ожида́ть — to expect, to anticipate; объясни́ть — to explain; опусти́ть — to let down, to lower, to sink (to allow to descend).
**довели** — довести́ (perfective): to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald; to drive, to reduce, to bring, to carry; to inform. Wiktionary: до- + вести́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What was it I left behind?
exercises.why: **оставил** — оста́вить (perfective): to leave, to leave alone; to abandon; to give up; to drop, to stop. Wiktionary: о- + ста́вить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to declare, to tell, to advertise, to express
to light, to light up, to illuminate
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: объяви́ть — to declare, to tell, to advertise, to express; облако — (meteorology) cloud; освети́ть — to light, to light up, to illuminate; обраща́ть — to turn; to direct.
**Оставь** — оста́вить (perfective): to leave, to leave alone; to abandon; to give up; to drop, to stop. Wiktionary: о- + ста́вить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I forced him to carry the suitcase.
exercises.why: **обязал** — обяза́ть (perfective): to oblige, to bind. Wiktionary: об- + вяза́ть.

exercises.q: He put his arm around her.
exercises.why: **обнял** — обня́ть (perfective): to hug, to embrace; to engulf, to envelop. Wiktionary: об- + -ня́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to bring to stop
